title: Seeker aspic

infobox.Crafting Materials: Seeker meat x2, Magecap x2, Royal jelly x2

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Seeker aspic is a Mistlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Two Seeker aspic are produced at a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 2 Magecap
• 2 Royal jelly
• 2 Seeker meat

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Seeker aspic provides the highest eitr gain in the Mistlands at 85.
• Two pieces of royal jelly yields two seeker aspics (a 2:2 ratio of royal jelly to aspic), whereas two pieces of royal jelly yield only one Yggdrasil porridge (a 2:1 ratio of royal jelly to porridge).

Introduction. Seeker aspic is a Mistlands-tier food.

Recipe. Two Seeker aspic are produced at a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 2 Magecap
• 2 Royal jelly
• 2 Seeker meat

Notes. • Seeker aspic provides the highest eitr gain in the Mistlands at 85.
• Two pieces of royal jelly yields two seeker aspics (a 2:2 ratio of royal jelly to aspic), whereas two pieces of royal jelly yield only one Yggdrasil porridge (a 2:1 ratio of royal jelly to porridge).
